server.name: btp-cf-mcp-server
server.description: MCP server for the Cloud Foundry V3 API on SAP BTP

entitySets.description: Cloud Foundry applications — deploy, manage, start, and stop apps. To start/stop/restart, POST to path /<guid>/actions/start|stop|restart (use the create operation). Supports filtering by names, space_guids, organization_guids, stacks. Pagination via page and per_page query params. CF V3 REST paths, not OData: '/<guid>' for one resource; list with query params like '?names=a,b&per_page=50&page=2'

Cloud Foundry application builds — staging a package into a droplet. Create a build to stage an app package. CF V3 REST paths, not OData: '/<guid>' for one resource; list with query params like '?names=a,b&per_page=50&page=2'

Cloud Foundry app deployments — rolling deployments and canary releases. Use the create operation (POST) with path /<guid>/actions/cancel to cancel an in-progress deployment. CF V3 REST paths, not OData: '/<guid>' for one resource; list with query params like '?names=a,b&per_page=50&page=2'

Cloud Foundry droplets — the staged, runnable artifacts produced from builds. Filter by app_guids, states, current. CF V3 REST paths, not OData: '/<guid>' for one resource; list with query params like '?names=a,b&per_page=50&page=2'

Cloud Foundry packages — application source code or Docker images uploaded for staging. Filter by app_guids, states, types. CF V3 REST paths, not OData: '/<guid>' for one resource; list with query params like '?names=a,b&per_page=50&page=2'

Cloud Foundry processes — running instances of an app (web, worker, etc.). Use the create operation (POST) with path /<guid>/actions/scale to scale instances, memory, or disk. Filter by app_guids, space_guids, types. CF V3 REST paths, not OData: '/<guid>' for one resource; list with query params like '?names=a,b&per_page=50&page=2'

Cloud Foundry tasks — one-off processes (e.g. database migrations, batch jobs) that run to completion. Use the create operation (POST) with path /<guid>/actions/cancel to cancel a running task. Filter by app_guids, names, states. CF V3 REST paths, not OData: '/<guid>' for one resource; list with query params like '?names=a,b&per_page=50&page=2'

Cloud Foundry organizations — top-level containers for spaces, apps, and users. Filter by names, guids. CF V3 REST paths, not OData: '/<guid>' for one resource; list with query params like '?names=a,b&per_page=50&page=2'

Cloud Foundry spaces — subdivisions within an org where apps and services are deployed. Filter by names, organization_guids, guids. CF V3 REST paths, not OData: '/<guid>' for one resource; list with query params like '?names=a,b&per_page=50&page=2'

Cloud Foundry roles — user role assignments in orgs and spaces (e.g. OrgManager, SpaceDeveloper). Filter by types, user_guids, organization_guids, space_guids. CF V3 REST paths, not OData: '/<guid>' for one resource; list with query params like '?names=a,b&per_page=50&page=2'

Cloud Foundry users — user accounts associated with the CF deployment. Filter by guids, usernames, origins. CF V3 REST paths, not OData: '/<guid>' for one resource; list with query params like '?names=a,b&per_page=50&page=2'

Cloud Foundry service instances — provisioned instances of marketplace services (databases, message queues, etc.). Filter by names, space_guids, service_plan_guids, type. CF V3 REST paths, not OData: '/<guid>' for one resource; list with query params like '?names=a,b&per_page=50&page=2'

Cloud Foundry service credential bindings — service keys and app bindings that provide credentials to access a service instance. Filter by service_instance_guids, app_guids, type (app or key). CF V3 REST paths, not OData: '/<guid>' for one resource; list with query params like '?names=a,b&per_page=50&page=2'

Cloud Foundry service offerings — the services available in the marketplace from registered service brokers. Filter by names, service_broker_guids, available. CF V3 REST paths, not OData: '/<guid>' for one resource; list with query params like '?names=a,b&per_page=50&page=2'

Cloud Foundry service plans — the pricing/feature tiers available for each service offering. Filter by names, service_offering_guids, available, service_broker_guids. CF V3 REST paths, not OData: '/<guid>' for one resource; list with query params like '?names=a,b&per_page=50&page=2'

Cloud Foundry service brokers — the broker applications that advertise and provision service instances. Filter by names, space_guids. CF V3 REST paths, not OData: '/<guid>' for one resource; list with query params like '?names=a,b&per_page=50&page=2'

Cloud Foundry service route bindings — bind a service instance to a route for route-level request interception. Filter by service_instance_guids, route_guids. CF V3 REST paths, not OData: '/<guid>' for one resource; list with query params like '?names=a,b&per_page=50&page=2'

Cloud Foundry service usage events — historical record of service instance create/delete events for billing and auditing. Filter by service_instance_types, service_offering_guids. CF V3 REST paths, not OData: '/<guid>' for one resource; list with query params like '?names=a,b&per_page=50&page=2'

Cloud Foundry domains — shared or private domain names used to create routes (e.g. cfapps.eu10.hana.ondemand.com). Filter by names, organization_guids. CF V3 REST paths, not OData: '/<guid>' for one resource; list with query params like '?names=a,b&per_page=50&page=2'

Cloud Foundry routes — URL mappings that direct traffic to apps. Filter by hosts, paths, domain_guids, space_guids, organization_guids. CF V3 REST paths, not OData: '/<guid>' for one resource; list with query params like '?names=a,b&per_page=50&page=2'

Cloud Foundry security groups — egress firewall rules controlling which external endpoints apps can reach. Filter by names, guids, globally_enabled_running, globally_enabled_staging. CF V3 REST paths, not OData: '/<guid>' for one resource; list with query params like '?names=a,b&per_page=50&page=2'

Cloud Foundry buildpacks — the runtimes and frameworks used to stage applications (e.g. java_buildpack, nodejs_buildpack). Filter by names, stacks. CF V3 REST paths, not OData: '/<guid>' for one resource; list with query params like '?names=a,b&per_page=50&page=2'

Cloud Foundry feature flags — platform-level toggles that enable/disable CF features (e.g. user_org_creation, diego_docker). Use path /<flag_name> to get/update a specific flag. CF V3 REST paths, not OData: '/<name>' for one resource; list with query params like '?names=a,b&per_page=50&page=2'

Cloud Foundry stacks — the root filesystems (OS base images) used to run applications (e.g. cflinuxfs4). Filter by names. CF V3 REST paths, not OData: '/<guid>' for one resource; list with query params like '?names=a,b&per_page=50&page=2'

Cloud Foundry isolation segments — dedicated compute pools for running apps in isolated Diego cells. Filter by names, guids, organization_guids. CF V3 REST paths, not OData: '/<guid>' for one resource; list with query params like '?names=a,b&per_page=50&page=2'

Cloud Foundry async jobs — track the status of long-running operations (e.g. app delete, space delete). Poll by GUID until state is COMPLETE or FAILED. CF V3 REST paths, not OData: '/<guid>' for one resource; list with query params like '?names=a,b&per_page=50&page=2'

Cloud Foundry organization quotas — resource limits (memory, instances, routes, services) applied to orgs. Filter by names, guids, organization_guids. CF V3 REST paths, not OData: '/<guid>' for one resource; list with query params like '?names=a,b&per_page=50&page=2'

Cloud Foundry space quotas — resource limits applied to individual spaces within an org. Filter by names, guids, organization_guids, space_guids. CF V3 REST paths, not OData: '/<guid>' for one resource; list with query params like '?names=a,b&per_page=50&page=2'
